Players Committee card image of [[V-4X-D Ski Speeder]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 pilot. May move as a 'react'. Matching vehicle for any Resistance pilot. Pilot's power = 0, and when targeted by an Interrupt or weapon, may use this vehicle's defense value instead.” Uploaded unchanged.
